info.name: Micro HRMS — Completed APIs
info.description: Maintained with each completed topic. Import the environment template and read postman/README.md. Session cookies, not bearer tokens. Select individual requests/folders intentionally: this is an API reference, not an all-at-once runner scenario. Writes modify the selected environment. Only implemented routes are included. Documents use multipart uploads; select a local file before sending.

request.description: Public connectivity check; returns text. This is not a database readiness endpoint.

item.name: 01 — Authentication

request.description: Postman saves the session cookie automatically. Default email is microhrms@yopmail.com; supply your actual password locally. Logging in replaces the current session cookie for this host.
Use Company Admin/HR for management requests. Change tenant_email and tenant_password to test another user. Company is the slug, not the tenant UUID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('current_user_id', data.user.id); pm.environment.set('tenant_id', data.user.tenantId); }

request.description: Use after employee activation. This replaces the admin session cookie. Log in as the company admin again before management requests.
Returns current account and permissions. It does not overwrite target user_id.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('current_user_id', data.user.id); }

request.description: Uses the most recently issued invitation token (company admin, standalone user or employee). Choose the intended account password, minimum 15 characters. Activation does not log in. For a new company admin, use this same password as tenant_password.

Changes the currently signed-in account password and revokes sessions. Required first for a platform account with a temporary password. Set current_password and new_password locally, then update the matching login password variable.

Public company-account recovery, CSRF header required. Generic response whether the account exists or not. Requires active company/account and configured SMTP worker. 5 requests per company/email and 30 per IP per 15 minutes. The link is emailed only; never returned here. Use local Mailpit to obtain the test reset_token from the URL fragment after #. New requests replace earlier links. Platform recovery is not exposed.

Public, CSRF protected. Paste only the token after # from the latest email into reset_token. Expires after 30 minutes and works once. Use 15–128 characters. Revokes all account sessions without signing in automatically. Update tenant_password locally and sign in again. Never commit/export populated recovery secrets.
Signs out the active cookie session.
Revokes every session for the current account.

item.description: Company password recovery uses company code and email. Platform recovery and public registration are not exposed. Recovery links are delivered only by the configured SMTP worker.

request.description: Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

Employee code is generated; joining date defaults to account creation date and employment type to Not specified for HR review. Use a unique company_slug. Saves tenant_id and activation_token. Activate, then log in as the company user.

item.name: 07 — Users and roles

request.description: Run first to populate built-in role ID variables. Permission: roles.manage. Built-in roles are read-only; custom roles are company-specific.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); for (const role of data.roles) { if (['company_admin','hr','manager','employee'].includes(role.code)) pm.environment.set(role.code + '_role_id', role.id); } }

request.description: Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

Run role catalog first. Saves target user_id and activation_token. Include company_admin_role_id to automatically create a linked employee (or reuse an available unlinked employee with the same email). For other roles, invite existing employees from their profile. Admin creation consumes an employee place; capacity failure rolls back the account and invitation. Review generated employee details in Employees.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('user_id', data.id);pm.environment.set('activation_token', data.invitation.token); pm.environment.set('activation_expires_at', data.invitation.expires_at); }

Existing profiles and employment details are preserved. Revokes existing sessions; self-change and last-admin removal are blocked.
Immediately revokes sessions and pending tokens. Employment status stays unchanged. Cannot disable self or the last active Company Admin.
Cannot bypass an inactive/terminated employee. An unactivated user returns to Invited and needs a fresh invitation.

Requires company.manage. Includes location lookup options, date-only holiday entries, company timezone/today and deduplicated annual/upcoming date counts.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Requires company.manage and a same-company location. Includes company-wide holidays plus this location. Archived locations can be reviewed for history.

item.name: 09 — Attendance

request.description: Requires attendance.self and a linked employee. Omit month for the company-timezone current month. Returns recorded and explicitly marked projected days, schedule settings, summaries and today actions.

attendance.manage sees company employees; attendance.approve.team sees direct reports only. Use a returned id as employee_id. Supports search/page/limit. active_only=true restricts to active/on_notice employees; omit or use false to include other non-archived statuses. Returns department_name and location_name.
HR, permitted direct-report manager, or employee self. No personal/bank data is returned.

Log in as an active/on-notice employee with attendance.self and an assigned or unambiguous applicable schedule. Server time determines the date and timestamp. One pair per date; never accepts employee_id or client timestamps.
Completes today’s open check-in. For a prior-day missed checkout, submit a correction. Hours/status use saved schedule rules.

Self-service only. Both timestamps require Z or an explicit UTC offset, must fall on work_date in the recorded company timezone, and cannot be future times. Saves regularization_id. One pending request per date.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('regularization_id', data.id); }

Applies once. Rejects self-review, stale attendance and locked payroll dates. Preserves original values and audits changes.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Requires attendance.manage. Replaces times and recalculates status. Saved schedule snapshots are retained. Existing pending requests become stale and must be rejected/resubmitted.
Allowed modes: absent, leave, holiday, weekly_off. Replaces times with null and worked minutes with zero. Leave here is an HR attendance marker; it does not alter leave balances.

item.description: Single daily pair; no overnight shifts, overtime or multiple breaks. Set employee work schedule before testing. Times and business dates use company timezone. Locked payroll dates cannot be changed. Run individual requests intentionally, with the appropriate self/manager/HR identity.

item.name: 10 — Leave management

request.description: leave.self; linked employee. Includes assigned policies and credited, pending, used and available days. January–December year.
leave.manage sees company employees; leave.approve.team sees direct reports.

leave.manage. Server pagination; summary ignores the status filter. Active/on-notice employees with employment overlap. Status is assigned, partial, unassigned or not_applicable; completeness counts distinct applicable active leave types. Policy department/location scope and effective dates apply.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
leave.manage. Only active, applicable policies without an existing balance for this employee, leave type and year.

Creates a 30-minute draft only; does not credit leave. Maximum 10000 employees. For all matching pages set all_matching=true, remove employee_ids and supply directory filters. Both years must match. Existing balances are skipped; eligibility is rechecked at execution. Reuse an operation UUID only for identical input. One policy per batch; no bulk carry-forward.
202 Accepted; owner with leave.manage only. Confirms frozen employee IDs. Requires jobs:worker. Repeated confirmation does not recredit. Changed policies require a new preview.
Latest 20 jobs belonging to the current requester.
Owner only. Counts and 50 outcome rows per page. Poll until completed/failed; preview rows do not credit balances.
202 Accepted. Owner only; preserves already committed outcomes and balances. If the policy changed, create a new preview instead.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

leave.manage. Review the numeric year and credited amount in the body. One entitlement per employee/type/year. This assigns the policy within employment/effective dates and credits the reviewed annual amount, without automatic proration. For uncontrolled policies use credited=0. Carry-forward requires an enabled policy, sufficient previous-year available balance and no pending requests; it transfers those days out of the previous year.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('leave_balance_id', data.id); }

request.description: leave.manage. Positive or negative adjustment; available balance cannot go negative. Keep the same operation_id for a retry of the exact same operation; choose a fresh UUID for every new adjustment.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

leave.self. Read-only calculation, including balance and overlap validation. Requires assigned policy and a work schedule. Dates must be within one calendar year. For a single half-day set both start_half and end_half to am or pm. Multi-day ranges can start pm and end am.
Reserves controlled balance, snapshots policy/calendar inputs and rejects overlaps. Uncontrolled leave has no artificial balance limit.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('leave_request_id', data.id); }

HR company scope or manager direct reports. Self-review is forbidden. Use the response can_review/can_cancel flags.
Manager/direct-report or HR. Moves reserved units to used; validates attendance conflicts and payroll locks again. Cannot approve own leave.
Releases the pending reservation. Only pending requests can be reviewed.
Employee can cancel own pending leave. HR can cancel pending or approved leave. Approved cancellation restores balance and removes the attendance overlay; locked payroll dates block it.
Employee own scope, manager direct reports or HR company scope. Only approved chargeable dates; excludes sensitive leave reasons, categories and paid flags.

item.description: Leave workflows with tenant isolation and audited balance movements. Run deliberately with the required employee/reviewer/HR identity. Initialize policies and entitlements before applying.

request.description: Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

payroll.manage. Default is off. Set true only when HR enables approved unpaid-leave deductions. Applies to NEW runs; existing runs retain their saved setting. Fixed components and calendar-day proration; no automatic statutory rates.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.

Monthly amounts are DECIMAL STRINGS, not JSON numbers. Use active same-company earning/deduction component IDs. New revisions must follow the latest effective date; the previous revision closes automatically. Dates affecting locked payroll are rejected.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('salary_structure_id', data.id); }

request.description: Replaces the component allocation within the same effective dates. Removed lines retain zero amounts. Cannot affect a locked period; existing unlocked payroll requires recalculation.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
One run per calendar month. Copies currency and unpaid-leave configuration. Assign employee salaries before calculation.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('payroll_run_id', data.id); }

request.description: Run before EVERY calculation/adjustment/review/lock/publish after a mutation. Captures the current revision and version, preventing approval from a stale screen. Choose payroll_employee_id from current items; it is a payroll item UUID, not the employee profile UUID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('payroll_revision_id', data.run.calculation_config.revision); pm.environment.set('payroll_calculation_version', data.run.calculation_version); }

request.description: Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Creates a retained calculation version. Explicitly set discard_adjustments=true if replacing a version containing nonzero manual adjustments. Missing salary coverage aborts the entire calculation.

payroll_employee_id is the current payroll item. Reuse operation_id only for a retry of the identical action; use a new UUID for every distinct adjustment. Amounts are decimal strings. Changing amounts clears review.
Refresh the run revision and enter the current expected_amount. Set amount=0.00 to void a manual line while retaining history. Cannot edit generated lines or old calculation versions.
Requires calculated status and unchanged salary/employment/unpaid-leave inputs. Refresh run details after success.

Irreversible through this release. Month must have ended; resolve pending leave and attendance corrections first. Rechecks current inputs and freezes the period against attendance/leave changes. Refresh run details after success.

202 Accepted. Locked runs only. The separate jobs:worker generates PDFs in private PAYSLIP_STORAGE_DIR and atomically publishes the whole batch. Poll payslip-job for status. Repeating a failed request retries generation; successful repeats are idempotent. Shared persistent storage required; non-ASCII names require PAYSLIP_FONT_PATH. Sends configured payslip notifications after publication; does not pay employees.
payroll.manage required. Returns job or null. Poll pending/running until completed or failed. PDFs become visible only after the entire batch is published.
payslips.read.self. Only the linked employee’s own published/locked payslips. Choose payslip_id from the list; HR can also use a published current payroll item ID.
Employee owner or payroll.manage. Returns only the pay statement, excluding private file keys and full calculation inputs.
Authenticated binary application/pdf response with no-store caching. Use Postman Save Response / Send and Download. Owner or payroll.manage only.

item.description: Monthly payroll workflow. Refresh run details between mutations to update revision/version variables. Monetary request values must be strings. Earlier calculations are retained; locking has no undo endpoint.

item.name: 12 — Document management

request.description: HR: all company records. Employee: own shared records. documents.read.team: explicitly team-visible direct-report documents only. expiry=expired or expiring (next 30 days in company time).
documents.manage required. Select employee_id from the intended employee; no automatic selection.

HR only. Body > form-data: choose one local file in file field. PDF/PNG/JPEG, nonempty, max 10 MiB. Do not set Content-Type manually; Postman supplies the boundary. New operation UUID per new document; retain UUID and identical fields/file for retries. Visibility defaults to this example: hr_only.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('document_id', data.id); }

request.description: Captures revision for mutations. Select document_version_id explicitly from versions; earlier versions are retained. Private storage keys are never returned.
HR only. Refresh detail first. Full metadata replacement; empty dates clear them. Changes apply to sharing of all versions.
HR only. Choose file in form-data. New operation UUID per replacement; reuse for retry. Refresh detail revision before uploading. Prior files are retained.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('document_version_id', data.id); }

request.description: Authenticated binary attachment, no-store. Use Send and Download. HR can access retained archived files; employees/managers cannot. Every successful download is audited.
HR only. Refresh detail revision first. Hides this version from employee/team; newest remaining active version becomes current. Cannot archive the last active version of an active document.
HR only. Hides the entire document from employee/team. Files remain retained for HR and continue counting toward storage quota. No hard deletion or restore endpoint.

item.description: Private document library with audited uploads, immutable file versions, expiry metadata and scoped sharing. Select individual requests intentionally.

item.name: 13 Dashboard and reports

request.description: Tenant dashboard. Each widget uses its domain company/team/self scope. Payroll status requires payroll.manage; payslips and balances are personal. No report permission is needed.
Choose employees, attendance, leave, balances, payroll or components. Requires a reporting permission AND the matching domain permission. Returns scoped organization filters and payroll runs.

Default attendance uses month-to-date. Attendance: from/to <=31 days; leave requests: <=366 days. Balances: year. Payroll/components: enable run_id. Date/year/run filters are exclusive to their corresponding report. Max 5000 matching rows; 413 requires narrower filters.

Use Send and Download. Default body is for attendance or leave. For employees use {}; balances use {"year":2026}; payroll/components use {"run_id":"<payroll UUID>"}. Optional search/employee_id/department_id/location_id and supported status. Exports all matching rows, ignores pagination, capped at 5000. UTF-8 BOM, quoted and formula-safe. Export is audited and CSRF protected.

202 Accepted. Requires jobs:worker. Default filters suit attendance/leave; employees: operation_id only; balances: add year; payroll/components: add run_id. Maximum 100000 rows/50 MiB. Reuse operation_id only to safely repeat the SAME request; use a new UUID for a fresh snapshot or changed filters. Limits: 3 active jobs per requester, 31 attendance days/366 leave days.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Owner only. Poll pending/running until completed/failed. Status includes progress and safe error codes; never file paths or report data.

Use Send and Download. Owner only and current report/domain/team access is checked again. Completed files expire after 24 hours (410); pending/failed returns 409. CSV is UTF-8 BOM, quoted and formula-safe.
202 Accepted. Owner with current permission only; failed jobs only. Resets the three-attempt budget and queues the same filters. Expired/completed jobs require a new operation UUID.

item.description: Operational reporting with tenant and domain scopes. Small synchronous CSV and large background CSV exports. XLSX/PDF reports remain outside this release.

item.name: 14 Notifications and email delivery

request.description: Own notifications only. status=all|read|unread. Includes total and unread count plus an authorized-screen link; no invitation tokens or delivery payloads. Set notification_id manually from your own list.
Use a company account with the required permission. Cookie authentication is handled by Postman.
Own notification only. Change read to false to mark it unread. Other users/tenants receive 404.
Marks your currently unread notifications read. Does not change another user’s inbox.

company.manage required. status=pending|sent|failed|skipped, or disable status for all. Only delivery metadata is returned. Set notification_delivery_id explicitly from this list. Sent means SMTP accepted, not inbox delivery/read confirmation.

company.manage required; failed non-invitation delivery only. Requeues the existing record and audits the action. Worker rechecks current recipient access. For failed invitations, use the existing replacement-invitation API to issue a fresh activation link. SMTP must be configured and the separate worker running.

item.description: In-app workflow notifications and durable PostgreSQL outbox → Redis/BullMQ → SMTP delivery. SMTP is captured by local Mailpit in development; no general-purpose send-email API is exposed.

item.name: 15 Audit logs and activity history

request.description: company.manage required. Read-only, newest first; inclusive UTC dates. Actor searches current user name/email, case-insensitively as literal text. No raw metadata. Set audit_event_id from a chosen row. Tenant identity comes only from the session.
Tenant-scoped action codes and module prefixes recorded in this company. company.manage required.
company.manage required. Own-tenant event only; unknown/cross-tenant IDs return 404. Selected safe operational details only; private reasons, payroll values, snapshots and credentials are excluded.

item.description: Read-only company activity, including existing historical events. No edit/delete/export endpoint. System/platform entries may have no tenant actor. Current user identity is shown, not a historical name snapshot.
